title: Negros trade fair generates P118M in sales, up 39% from last year

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The 40th Negros Trade Fair (NTF) ’Butlak 2026’ generated around P118 million in combined reported sales, reflecting strong market demand for Negrense products and enterprises, NTF chairperson MaryAnn Colmenares said. Organized by the Association of Negros Producers (ANP), the six-day trade fair was held at SMX Convention Center at SM Aura Premier, from Sept. 22 to 27. Colmenares said P75 million came from spot sales, while P43 million came from business-to-business sales, including business orders and transactions generated through institutional buyers, retailers, distributors, and other business partners.
